description: Fetch live, normalized open job postings for one or more companies across 7 keyless ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workday, Recruitee, Workable). Platform and board token are auto-detected from a bare slug or domain. Returns a unified schema: title, company, location, remote, url, source_platform, posted_at. Free. Derived layers (normalized comp, hiring-intent) and a hosted 10-ATS feed are metered — call get_premium_access.

companies.description: Company slugs ("stripe"), domains ("stripe.com"), or explicit "platform:token" (e.g. "ashby:openai"). 1-25 entries.

includeDescription.description: Include full job description text when true (default false).

maxPerCompany.description: Cap postings returned per company (default 25, max 200).

name: search_jobs
